hero.title: Automotive research & consulting for decisions that carry strategic weight.
hero.content: Since 1992, L+H has supported demanding research and consulting projects in the automotive industry: from volume clinics and design studies to ethnography, online research, and board-ready, condensed results. We combine methodological currency, critical judgment, flexible execution, and result presentations that hold up even in front of demanding boards.
